why: A cold verification pass found these three quantities in the manuscript text and in no deposit. They are recomputed here from the archived .sto under the same Gate G.

speed_control.definition: pelvis forward translation over the analysed window divided by its duration
speed_control.CAVEAT: walking speed is a consequence of the lesion, not a variable independent of it, so this adjusts a mediator. It is an indication of scale, not a bound.

peak_swing_dorsiflexion_deg.definition: mean over kept cycles of the maximum ankle angle during the swing span
